description: This file contains a shell script for testing git tracking branch updates and push behavior. It sets up a test environment with multiple branches, performs push operations, and verifies the impact on tracking branches, including deletion and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.
